HediffDef.label: last stand
HediffDef.description: Everyone else is down. There is no one left to fall back to, so there is no reason to fall back. Pain is distant, hands are steady, and fear can wait until later.\n\nWhen it wears off, exhaustion hits all at once.

li.label: stood alone
li.description: Everyone else was down and I was still standing. I held. I don't know how, but I held.

li.label: {0} stood over me
li.description: I was on the ground. The last thing I saw before passing out was them, still fighting, between me and the enemy.
